catalog.container_strategy: Preserve exact source and notices in immutable prepared materials. A reference adapter does not install or start this resource.
catalog.purpose: Reference LLVM test-suite producers, result schemas, historical comparisons and regression analysis. An isolated optional consumer must import the project's immutable measurements rather than introduce an independent scheduler.
qualification_gaps: Source qualification does not demonstrate build, container, runtime service or dependency closure readiness.

Historical llvm-opt-benchmark ID refers to an older LNT pin, not the dtcxzyw LLVM IR corpus. The root integration will correct that ID with a hash-guarded compatibility alias; historical manifests retain original identities.
Use a separate llvm-lnt Python environment: upstream requires SQLAlchemy==1.3.24 while the main research environment has SQLAlchemy 2.x.
Freeze runtime and build dependencies, including setuptools-scm. An exact GitHub archive lacks git metadata; set an explicit verified SCM package version during wheel preparation.
A source-only reference cannot substitute for the LNT CLI or a tested database/web deployment.
catalog.size_basis: Complete HTTPS payload measured locally; source logical bytes sum regular archive members and exclude filesystem allocation, external dependencies and build trees.
